main.description: Lists the repo-backed communities the requesting user belongs to that have not finished moving onto spaces. The AppView reads this live from the user's own public repo and each candidate's public repo. A community that cannot move, such as one inside its owner's repo or one whose repo did not respond, is listed in state blocked with a reason.

includeUnadministered.description: Whether to include communities the user belongs to but does not administer. They come back with viewerIsAdmin false.

communities.description: Unmigrated legacy communities, in the user's preferred sidebar order where the legacy repo recorded one. This is not paginated: a user's community list is small and every entry costs a live read.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The requesting user's own PDS could not be read, so no candidate list could be built at all.
